title: Do Not Drink Advisory — Zone 1 Water Quality Emergency

fields.office: Division of Drinking and Ground Waters, Central District
fields.subject: Do Not Drink Advisory — Elevated pH and Caustic Overfeed in Zone 1
fields.applicability: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer, all field and control personnel, public distribution points
fields.authority: Ohio Revised Code § 3745.01; EPA 40 CFR 141.12; ERP Section 4.4
fields.purpose: The Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District has confirmed a public health emergency due to a confirmed caustic overfeed in the Zone 1 distribution area. Laboratory results from Sample 24-1187 show a finished-water pH of 9.3 and a measured caustic dose of 38 mg/L, both exceeding safe limits. The control system is compromised and cannot be trusted to reflect actual conditions. This emergency constitutes a credible threat to public health under Section 4.3 of the Ohio Drinking Water Rule. The City must issue an official advisory to prevent ingestion of contaminated water.
actions: Immediately issue a Do Not Drink advisory for Zone 1, including all residents, businesses, and facilities served directly by the High Service Pump Station
Publish the advisory on the City’s website, MillbrookAlert, social media, and via SMS within 30 minutes of this notice
Provide bottled water distribution points at Zone 1 (Valley) and Northgate Zone 3 by 12:00 today
Report full compliance to the Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District via CISA WaterISAC portal within 2 hours
Maintain a 24-hour public hotline (555) 038-8800 for customer inquiries and health concerns
fields.contact: Questions: contact the Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District at (555) 037-1555 or via secure email to ddagw-central@epa.ohio.gov

approvedBy.name: Denise Albrecht
approvedBy.title: Director, Water Operations, City of Millbrook

instructorNote: This inject confirms the regulatory trigger for the official advisory. The IC must validate lab data with WQ and then authorize the full advisory release via PIO. Watch for delays in confirmation or hesitation on the advisory type.
